Minimum 2 years of experience in integration and leadership of multifunctional teams focused on data. Demonstrated skill in Advanced proficiency in BI tools and dashboard construction (Power BI / Qlik Sense). Advanced proficiency in ERP tools (SAP-PP / MM / PM).
